decisions: Clarify whether the buyer needs structure design, artwork support, material direction or a quote for an existing design.
Prepare product dimensions, weight, target sales channel, quantity range, artwork status and reference style before RFQ.
Separate visual design questions from manufacturing specifications so the factory review can be useful.
